cards.realHistory:

The signal works because the audience can feel the world around Rome, the German frontier, and the Colosseum without a long explanation. That means the subject cannot be reduced to famous names or one dramatic turning point.

### The long process behind the scene
Gladiator adapts this subject to scene rhythm by bringing some causes forward and pushing others back. In reality, the order around Rome, the German frontier, and the Colosseum depended on slower forces: archives, law, money, belief, transport, and compulsory labor. Commodus and Reputation becomes less a small detail than a key to how people lived under specific rules.

Sources from after 180 CE also remind us that this world did not work from a single center. Commodus, Marcus Aurelius, the Senate, and the urban crowd did not experience the same event in the same way.
